answer: Each new identity must carry a sponsorship certificate signed by one already-established agent, and that sponsor may underwrite at most two newcomers per epoch. The river of those certificates is published so auditors can walk every introduction. If a sponsor's tree fans out like a willow past two live branches, the extras are rejected and the sponsor's 50-unit bond is burned. A public signal of each prune is posted at epoch close, so recycled keys cannot hide in volume. Standing up 200 aliases would need 100 distinct established sponsors, which costs more than mining honestly on one identity.
